items.title: Your AI subscription renewal failed
items.content: Orbit AI Billing: We couldn't renew your AI subscription because the card on file has expired. Please update your payment method by Friday, April 12, to keep access to your paid plan.
items.context: Fictional review on April 8, 2030; next review April 10. This is the complete conversation, with no later replies or other open obligations. The reader uses this paid AI subscription, wants to keep it active and is responsible for billing. The payment method has not been updated.

items.title: Re: Final forms for your business taxes
items.content:
Morgan, tax preparer: I have the bookkeeping records for your business. Please send the final tax forms you received so I can finish preparing the return.
Recipient: Thanks, I'll gather them and send them over.
Morgan: Checking in: I'm still waiting on those final forms. Could you send them by Thursday, April 11, or reply with when they'll be ready? I can't finish the return until I have them.
items.context: Fictional review on April 8, 2030; next review April 10. This is the complete conversation. The reader owns this business and is responsible for supplying the forms to their existing tax preparer. The reader's acknowledgment was sent, but the forms have not been sent and the latest request remains unanswered. Thursday is the preparer's requested handoff date, not a claimed legal filing deadline. No account change, document transfer or sending action is authorized by this source.

items.title: The best Substack
items.content: Technically Curious: Your weekly dose of AI news and practical ideas is here. This issue covers useful model updates, a hands-on workflow to try and a guide to deciding which tools deserve your attention. Happy reading!
